An earthquake in Vancouver had a magnitude of 6.3 on the Richter scale. An earthquake in Japan had a magnitude of 8.9 on the Richter scale. How many times more intense was the Japan earthquake than the Vancouver earthquake? You may use the formula below:

$M = log (frac(A, A _(0)))$

committee of 4 students that has at least 1 girl.

Without actually solving the problem, explain the strategy you would use to find the total number

of ways to select this committee.

solution.text:
Method 1
Find all ways to form the committee and subtract the number of ways with no girls on the committee.
Method 2
Find all scenarios with girls on the committee: 1 girl on the committee, 2 girls on the committee, 3 girls
on the committee, and a committee with all girls. Then add all scenarios together to get the total number
of ways to create a committee with at least 1 girl.
